description: This file defines the SaleTax controller class for the OpenCart admin report extension, handling display, saving settings, and generating tax reports related to sales.

classes.name: SaleTax
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale tax reports in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the report page, loads language, sets breadcrumbs, and renders the sale tax form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of sale tax report settings, checks permissions, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the sale tax report, loads order statuses, and renders the report view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the sale tax report list.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the sale tax report data as a view, with filtering, pagination, and data retrieval.
